1.w: For the one directing. According to Muth-Labben. A Psalm of David. I will confess YHWH with all of my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.

2.w: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise [to] Your name, O Most High.

3.w: In turning back my enemies they shall stumble and shall perish from Your face.

4.w: For You have done my justice and my claim; You have sat on the throne, judging [with] righteousness.

5.w: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; their name You have wiped out forever and ever.

6.w: May the enemy be finished in ruins forever, and You have uprooted cities; let their remembrance perish with them!

7.w: And YHWH shall sit forever; He has established His throne for the judgment.

8.w: And He will judge the world in righteousness; He shall make judgment [for] the peoples in uprightness.

9.w: And YHWH will be a secure height for the oppressed, a secure height in times of distress.

10.w: And they will put their trust in You—those knowing Your name—for You have not forsaken those seeking You, O YHWH.

11.w: Sing praise to YHWH, the One sitting [in] Zion; declare His deeds among the peoples.

12.w: For the One seeking out the blood remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the afflicted.

13.w: Show favor to me, O YHWH; see my affliction from those hating me; raise me high from the gates of death,

14.w: so that I may recount all Your praises in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Your salvation.

15.w: The nations have sunk down into the pit they have made; in the net that they hid, their foot is caught.

16.w: YHWH is known by the justice He has done; by the work of his own hands the wicked one is snared. Higgaion Selah

17.w: the wicked shall return to Sheol—all the nations forgetting God.

18.w: For the needy will not be forgotten forever, [nor] the hope of the poor perish to the [end].

19.w: Arise, O YHWH! Do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged before Your face.

20.w: Put fear on them, O YHWH; let the nations know they [are] mortal. Selah
